title: Create article with valid payload
steps: POST /articles with valid token and non-empty title/description/body
expected_result: HTTP 201 and created article object returned

title: Verify create response fields
expected_result: Response includes required article identity content and author metadata

title: Duplicate title unique slug
steps: Create two articles with identical title
expected_result: Both creates succeed and returned slugs differ

title: Owner updates body
steps: PUT /articles/{slug} with owner token and new body
expected_result: Update succeeds and body reflects new value

title: Partial update preserves fields
steps: PUT only body then GET same slug

title: Omitted tagList preserves tags
steps: PUT update payload without tagList field

title: Non-empty tagList replaces tags
expected_result: Article tagList replaced by supplied values

title: Deleted article cannot be fetched
expected_result: Retrieval fails or indicates not-found semantics

title: Update attempt by unauthenticated or non-owner is rejected
steps: PUT /articles/{slug} without token or with token of a different author
expected_result: Request is rejected and article state is unchanged

title: Delete attempt by unauthenticated or non-owner is rejected
steps: DELETE /articles/{slug} without token or with token of a different author
expected_result: Request is rejected and article remains available to owner

title: Deleted article is absent from detail and list reads
steps: DELETE as owner then GET detail and GET list with relevant filters
expected_result: Deleted article is not returned by detail or list endpoints
